notes.title: We're Joining The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Get ready! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival, running from February 28th at 02:00 GMT+8 to March 31st, 2025, at 02:00 GMT+8!

The 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival marks a first-of-its-kind event, bringing together indie game developers from around the globe for a Ramadan-themed sale. It's a fantastic opportunity for indie devs and game lovers to connect, share ideas, and celebrate Ramadan together.

During the festival, feel free to check out and play the latest games and grab some awesome discounts from across Asia! We hope you have a blast!

notes.title: "Before Fate": New Demo "Whispers of the Otherworld" Coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear Researchers,

We are thrilled to introduce exciting [b]new[/b] content! To celebrate the upcoming Steam Next Fest, we are launching a standalone prologue for "Before Fate" - "Whispers of the Otherworld"! This is a compact adventure where you will delve into the mysterious events at Sunrise Farm, uncovering the truths hidden behind time and space.

[b]New Demo Prologue: "Whispers of the Otherworld"[/b]
[list]
[*] The demo for "Whispers of the Otherworld" will be available for a limited time during the Steam Next Fest from October 14 at 10 AM to October 21 at 10 AM (PT/UTC-7).
[*] In this brand-new adventure, our protagonist, Ian, will take on a commission from the police to investigate the mystery of an unidentified flying object crash at the enigmatic Sunrise Farm.
[*] You will experience bizarre time rifts, the intertwining of time and space, inexplicable illusions, and the ultimate test against a massive gelatinous entity.
[*] This adventure will challenge your wit and courage, as the forces of time and space quietly guide every choice you make.
[/list]
This demo serves as a prologue to the storyline of "Before Fate", revealing some key clues, but the mysteries will unfold further in the full version. Come and experience it, and unlock even more secrets hidden within!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528655/9ef3815b4ae6efd8dd63ad8b0b452d2dc5c9c568.png[/img]

[b]Add us to your wishlist, stay updated on our latest progress, participate in discussions, and share your theories with fellow researchers![/b]

Thank you for your support and participation!

The Before Fate Team

notes.title: Before Fate Demo Ending Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Researchers,

Thank you for your incredible support for [i]Before Fate[/i]! Our event is ending soon. We have received a wealth of valuable feedback, which we will incorporate into our optimization plan to enhance your experience in the upcoming update.

In the next demo, based on the current version, we will introduce even more challenging content. We look forward to reconnecting with you soon and delivering more exciting adventures!

Thank you once again for your support and feedback!

The Before Fate Team

notes.title: Before Fate Limited Time Demo 1.0.73 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello, researchers! Here’s what's new in the latest update for [i]Before Fate[/i]:

[b][B4F8] Patch Update v1.0.73[/b]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed AI pathfinding ignoring obstacles on the far left side of the town.
[*] Fixed issue where immobile monsters could cause the game to crash.
[*] Corrected torch overlapping issue.
[*] Fixed hunger buff not displaying when weakened.
[*] Fixed guide weapon sway and trajectory jittering in auto-aim mode.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Invisible enemies will now show hit effects when detected by sensors.
[*] Unarmed attacks and some other attacks will now have directional targeting.
[*] In auto-aim mode, the character will maintain aim for a period after attacking.
[*] Advanced recipes no longer require crafting the previous tier; having the recipe alone is sufficient for activation.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the prompt button not properly graying out when the Neogen System cannot activate projects.
[*] Fixed the prompt button not properly graying out for unbound key options in the control settings.
[*] Differentiated the UI color for energy weapon and ammo weapon capacity.
[/list]
[b]Scenes[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized map area notifications for the Forest Whisperer Tribe Ruins.
[*] The AI pathfinding in each large scene is carried out in partitions. If it exceeds a certain range, it will be out of combat state.
[/list]

notes.title: Before Fate Limited Time Demo 1.0.72 Minor Patch Update
notes.content:
Dear Researchers,

Thank you for your valuable feedback on the [i]Before Fate[/i] demo! We appreciate every opinion and will continue to update the game during the demo period to ensure the best gaming experience. Here are the main updates in version [b]1.0.72[/b]:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed performance issues causing noticeable lag when a large number of buffs are active.
[*] Resolved issues with filter effects failing to transition properly between scenes (now directly switches to the target effect).
[*] Corrected visual rendering issues where invincibility effects caused incorrect display of dark buff when switching scenes.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced combat experience with the final two monsters in the prologue.
[*] Disabled all accessory effect displays upon character death.
[*] Improved transition effect of the white screen when awakening at the start of the prologue.
[*] Refined flashlight effects.
[*] Accelerated text display speed; now significantly faster, with consistent text speed in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Adjusted walking sound volume from 0.25 to 0.15.
[/list]
[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized mouse aiming for smoother performance.
[*] Enhanced controls settings with a confirmation dialog for changes; changes will only be applied after confirmation, preventing unintended alterations.
[/list]
We will continuously adjust and improve the game based on your feedback. If you encounter any issues or have further suggestions, please use the [b]in-game feedback[/b] form to let us know, and we will work on improvements as soon as possible.

We hope you continue to enjoy your adventure in [i]Before Fate[/i]!

Best regards,

The Before Fate Team
